Converts Fedora update data (`Updates`) into a slice of `models.Definition` structs for use with the OVAL dictionary data model.

## Key Components

### `ConvertToModel(data *Updates) []models.Definition`
The sole exported function. Iterates over `data.UpdateList` and maps each update entry to a `models.Definition`, including:

- **CVEs** — builds `[]models.Cve` with MITRE URLs from each CVE ID
- **Packages** — builds `[]models.Package` with version strings formatted as `epoch:version-release`
- **References & Bugzillas** — splits references into generic `[]models.Reference` and Bugzilla-specific `[]models.Bugzilla`
- **Timestamps** — parses `Issued` and `Updated` dates via `util.ParsedOrDefaultTime`
- **Rejected entries** — skips any update whose description contains `"** REJECT **"`
- **`no-details` mode** — when the `no-details` Viper flag is set, strips title, description, severity, bugzillas, CPEs, timestamps, and references from the output

## Usage Example

```go
updates := &fedora.Updates{ /* populated from fetched data */ }

defs := fedora.ConvertToModel(updates)
for _, def := range defs {
    fmt.Println(def.DefinitionID, def.Advisory.Severity)
}
```

## Notes

- Version strings follow RPM convention: `epoch:version-release`
- `DefinitionID` is always prefixed with `"def-"` (e.g., `"def-FEDORA-2024-abc123"`)
- Depends on [`github.com/spf13/viper`](https://github.com/spf13/viper) for runtime flag resolution; ensure `no-details` is configured before calling
- Source lives at [`flamingo-stack/fleetmdm`](https://github.com/flamingo-stack/fleetmdm/blob/main/fedora.go)
